provenance.scope: 150 core runs at step 0; all 17 half-pass grid checkpoints of 50 Qwen0.5B core runs; the same 17 grid checkpoints of five Qwen0.5B RLEP Pantry runs
provenance.source_policy: Discovery audit reads all historical debug-job logs to expose collisions; it does not admit or select any efficacy outcome. Recovery-authorized source binding is assessed separately in the companion report.
provenance.identity_policy: Compare full metrics dictionaries and separate response-free prompt/request projections, with row numbers and SHA-256 of every complete source file.
limitations: Does not audit noninitial checkpoints of Falcon or Qwen3B core runs.
RLEP files also contain quarter-pass checkpoints; this frozen discovery scan checks the stated half-pass grid only.
Training correctness, checkpoint-state equivalence, and individual-mode histories are outside this audit.
